name: cx-goal-many-rules
task: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed. Whenever you are holding the key, try to have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards. Then open the door with the key and pick up the box in the other room.
texts: The agent must move the blocker ball away from the door before taking the key
The blocker ball must be moved before the key is taken
If the key is lost, the door should be open afterwards
While holding the key, the door should be open at that moment or afterwards
The key must be held before the door can be opened
The door must be opened before picking up the target box
The agent must eventually open the door
The agent must eventually pick up the target box
